title: SiteMask
description: Terrain horizon mask for one curated site (web/public/data/masks/{id}.json), built by the engine's native mask builder.

id.description: Site id (no units); equals the id in sites.json and the file name.

aspect_deg.description: Compass direction the site slope faces (downhill), degrees clockwise from local north in [0, 360); optional until the mask builder (ENG-3 / PIPE-8) writes it.

slope_deg.description: Terrain slope at the site in degrees from horizontal, in [0, 90].

bins.description: Number of azimuth bins (unitless count); equals mask_deg.length. Fixed at 360 for curated sites.

mask_deg.description: mask_deg[i] is the terrain horizon elevation angle in degrees at azimuth i * (360 / bins) degrees (clockwise from local north). Elevation is measured above the local horizontal plane; a body is hidden when it is below this angle.

max_distance_km.description: Distance in kilometres out to which terrain was searched when building the mask.

dem_source.description: Name and resolution of the elevation model the mask was built from (no units), e.g. LOLA LDEM_80S_80MPP_ADJ; its URL is in source_urls.
